title: On generation of the groups GL_n(q) and PGL_n(q) by three involutions, two of which commute

publication.journal: Trudy Instituta Matematiki i Mekhaniki UrO RAN

dimension_four_consequence: For odd q, PGL4(q) is generated by three involutions with two commuting iff q=3 mod4. The source page248 gives the rank-three polytope implication.
reading_scope: Introduction, Theorems1–2, tables and rank-three adapter on printed pp247–248, plus selected preliminary lemmas; no complete proof audit.
unresolved_in_this_investigation: Proper diagonal index-two subgroup over PSL4(q) when q=1 mod4; no global openness assertion.
